cases.sentence: Он взял с собой двух ___, Монассию и Ефрема.
cases.translation: He took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
cases.explain: The numeral двух governs the genitive plural.

cases.sentence: Бог Всемогущий явился мне в ___, в земле Ханаана.
cases.translation: God Almighty appeared to me at Luz, in the land of Canaan.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Дам эту землю вечное владение твоим ___.
cases.translation: I will give this land as an everlasting possession to your descendants.
cases.explain: The recipients of the land (your descendants) stand in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Поэтому я похоронил ее там, у ___ в Ефрафу.
cases.translation: So I buried her there, by the road to Ephrath.
cases.explain: The preposition у (by, beside) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: Joseph took them away from Israel's knees.
cases.explain: The preposition от (away from) governs the genitive plural.

cases.sentence: Израиль протянул правую руку и возложил ее на ___ Ефрема.
cases.translation: Israel stretched out his right hand and laid it on Ephraim's head.
cases.explain: The preposition на expressing motion onto a surface takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он огорчился и взял отца за ___.
cases.translation: He was displeased and took his father by the hand.
cases.explain: The preposition за in the sense of grasping by something takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Лишний горный кряж, который я отвоевал у Амореев ___ и луком.
cases.translation: An extra mountain ridge, which I took from the Amorites with sword and bow.
cases.explain: The instrument or means of an action (with a sword) stands in the instrumental case.

reading.ru: Некоторое время спустя Иосифу сказали, «Твой отец болен», и он взял с собой двух сыновей, Монассию и Ефрема.
reading.question: What news prompted Joseph to visit with his two sons?
reading.explain: The text says Joseph was told 'Твой отец болен' (your father is sick).

reading.ru: Глаза Израиля ослабли от старости, он почти ослеп.
reading.question: What was wrong with Israel's eyes?
options: They had weakened from old age and he was nearly blind
They were injured in a fall
They had been healed by God
reading.correct: They had weakened from old age and he was nearly blind
reading.explain: The text says Israel's eyes had grown weak from age and he was nearly blind.

reading.ru: Но Израиль протянул правую руку и возложил ее на голову Ефрема, хотя он и был младше, а левую, перекрестив руки, он возложил на голову Монассии, хотя Монассия был первенцем.
reading.question: On whose head did Israel place his right hand?
reading.explain: Israel crossed his hands and laid his right hand on Ephraim, though he was the younger.

reading.ru: Но отец отказался и сказал, «Я знаю, мой сын, я знаю».
reading.question: How did Israel respond when Joseph tried to move his hand?
options: He refused, saying he knew what he was doing
reading.correct: He refused, saying he knew what he was doing
reading.explain: The text says the father refused and said 'Я знаю, мой сын, я знаю' (I know, my son, I know).

reading.ru: Я умираю, но Бог будет с вами и возвратит вас в землю ваших отцов.
reading.question: What did Israel promise Joseph before dying?
options: God would bring them back to the land of their fathers
Joseph would rule all Egypt forever
His sons would grow rich in Egypt
reading.correct: God would bring them back to the land of their fathers
reading.explain: Israel says God will be with them and return them 'в землю ваших отцов' (to the land of your fathers).

reading.ru: Иосиф отвел их от колен Израиля и поклонился ему низко до земли.
reading.question: What did Joseph do after taking his sons from Israel's knees?
options: He bowed low to the ground
reading.correct: He bowed low to the ground
reading.explain: The text says Joseph 'поклонился ему низко до земли' (bowed low to the ground before him).
